WALK-PAD CIPHER v1.3 - PUBLIC CHALLENGE SET
Reference implementation and spec: see the Walk-Pad v1.3 specification.
Commitments: SHA-256 of a 16-byte secret salt followed by the JSON of the secret
(sorted keys, Python json.dumps defaults). The salt is revealed when a challenge is claimed or closed.

CHALLENGE 1 - ciphertext only (q=64, P=256, L=512, one link)
Goal: recover the plaintext. Plaintext is uppercase English in the 6-bit chart.

CHALLENGE 2 - known plaintext (q=64, P=256, L=512, one link)
Goal: recover the key (W, C, e). The text portion of the plaintext is:
KNOWN PLAINTEXT CHALLENGE. THE TEXT OF THIS LINK IS PUBLISHED IN FULL. RECOVER THE WALK TABLE, THE COMBINER TABLE AND THE START CELL OF THE KEY THAT ENCRYPTED IT. GOOD LUCK.
(The 2-symbol header and 64-symbol carried table are not published; padding is END then zeros.)
Commitment SHA-256(salt||key json): e155774e5cf2727e7116e928319ac4110c38b27769adc733120932ced01d5846
Ciphertext:
